value: Malignancy (Boxed Warning: lymphomas, post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorders, hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, non-melanoma skin cancer)
Severe bone marrow suppression / myelosuppression (profound leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, aplastic anemia; markedly exacerbated in patients with TPMT or NUDT15 deficiency)
Severe, life-threatening opportunistic infections (bacterial, viral, fungal, protozoal)
Acute pancreatitis (hypersensitivity reaction, typically within weeks of starting; requires immediate cessation)
Hepatotoxicity (cholestasis, sinusoidal obstruction syndrome / veno-occlusive disease, peliosis hepatis)
Severe systemic hypersensitivity reactions (fever, rash, hypotension, arthralgias)

refs.quote: MALIGNANCY Chronic immunosuppression with IMURAN, a purine antimetabolite increases risk of malignancy in humans. Reports of malignancy include post-transplant lymphoma and hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma (HSTCL) in patients with inflammatory bowel disease.

value.effect: Inhibition of xanthine oxidase blocks the primary inactivation pathway of 6-mercaptopurine, leading to severe, life-threatening pancytopenia and myelosuppression.
value.management: Concomitant use with febuxostat is not recommended. If allopurinol is coadministered, reduce azathioprine dose to 25-33% of the usual dose and monitor complete blood count frequently.
